title: Sage routine record
description: A routine record (RoutineRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another routine record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

entries.description: What it does when, in order: the first entry whose hours (and days) hold is the one in force. (List<RoutineEntry>)

from.description: The hour it begins (inclusive); 8.5 is 08:30. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (double)

to.description: The hour it ends (exclusive); less than From wraps past midnight, equal is all day. Unit: h. Range: 0 to 24. (double)

days.description: The weekdays it holds on, as the calendar names them; empty = every day. (List<string>)

days+.description: Adds to "days": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

days-.description: Removes these from "days" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

schedule.description: The schedule it runs, usually MoveToAnchor, FaceAnchor and StayAt. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

at.description: Where: the name of an entity (a placement's name, a map entity's targetname) (string)

scene.description: The scene `at` is in, when it is not the one this creature is in; empty = this one. Names a scene record. (RecordId)
